# Global + LATAM AI & x402 API Suite (v2.5.0 — 10 Serverless Edge APIs)

> EN: 10 ultra-fast Cloudflare Edge microservices (10-30 ms in Latin America) for autonomous AI agents, fintechs, ERPs, n8n/LangChain workflows, and accounting automation. Pay per call in USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`) via x402 v2 — zero signup, zero API keys required (or optional B2B API Key).
> ES: 10 microservicios serverless en Cloudflare Edge para agentes de IA y fintechs en México, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Perú, Uruguay y Brasil. Pago por llamada en USDC (Base) vía protocolo x402 v2, sin registro previo.
> PT: 10 microsserviços serverless na borda Cloudflare para agentes autônomos de IA (3 ferramentas globais + 7 APIs fintech/fiscais LATAM e Brasil), monetizados nativamente via x402 v2 em USDC na Base ou chave B2B.

## Unified Gateway & MCP Server
- Unified API Hub: https://api.brunopompeo.com.br (`GET /llms.txt`, `GET /openapi.json`, `GET /catalog.json`, `GET /health`)
- Unified MCP Server (1 command): `npx -y github:brunopompeo1/brazil-ai-fiscal-apis-x402` (10 paid tools + 1 free status tool)
- Settlement Wallet (`payTo`): `0x20990fB239296a0A2d923C200Cb1C21187e2dA23` (USDC on Base `eip155:8453`)

## Global High-Volume Agent Tools (3)
1. **Agent Guard — Prompt Injection & PII Firewall** — `POST https://guard.brunopompeo.com.br/guard` ($0.008 USDC) | Hybrid Llama Guard 3 8B + heuristics + PII/secret redaction | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
2. **Web Enrichment — Clean HTML → Markdown & JSON Tables** — `GET https://web.brunopompeo.com.br/clean?url=<URL>&format=json` ($0.002 USDC) | Up to 85% token reduction for RAG & LLM agents | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
3. **Agent Email — Transactional Email Dispatcher** — `POST https://email.brunopompeo.com.br/send` ($0.005 USDC) | Pay-per-send Markdown→HTML email with `dryRun` mode, zero SaaS subscription | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`

## LATAM & Brazil Fintech / Fiscal Suite (7)
4. **LATAM Business, Fiscal & Banking Validator + Live FX (7 Countries)** — `POST https://latam.brunopompeo.com.br/latam` ($0.008 USDC) | MX (RFC, CURP, CLABE), AR (CUIT/CUIL, CBU), CL (RUT/RUN), CO (NIT), PE (RUC), UY (RUT), BR (CPF/CNPJ) + live FX (MXN/ARS/CLP/COP/PEN/UYU/BRL/USD/EUR) | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
5. **BR NF-e / NFC-e XML Auditor (SEFAZ 4.00)** — `POST https://nfe.brunopompeo.com.br/audit` ($0.010 USDC) | ~90% XML token savings, vProd/vNF math check, CFOP/NCM/IBS/CBS compliance | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
6. **BR DANFSe Nacional & Tax Reform (RTC CBS/IBS LC 214/2025)** — `POST https://danfse.brunopompeo.com.br/generate` ($0.005 USDC) | Official NFS-e Nacional 2026 DANFSe generator + CBS/IBS/ISS calculator | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
7. **BR Docs Parser — Boletos FEBRABAN, DARF/FGTS/IPTU & NF-e Keys** — `POST https://docs.brunopompeo.com.br/parse` ($0.008 USDC) | Post-Feb/2025 boleto factor engine + tax slip barcode decoder | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
8. **BR Tax & Payroll Engine (Simples Nacional, Fator R, CLT, INSS/IRRF)** — `POST https://tax.brunopompeo.com.br/calc` ($0.008 USDC) | Deterministic payroll, Simples Anexos I-V and B2B NFS-e withholdings | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
9. **BR Business Intel — CNPJ KYB Dossier, Geo-CEP & PIX EMVCo** — `POST https://intel.brunopompeo.com.br/intel` ($0.010 USDC) | Official Receita Federal QSA partners, risk score, IBGE CEP & PIX CRC16 | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
10. **BR Central Bank Financial Calculators (IPCA, IGP-M, Selic, CDI, PTAX, SAC/Price)** — `POST https://fin.brunopompeo.com.br/fin` ($0.005 USDC) | Official BCB monetary correction, PTAX FX and loan schedules | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
